title: OWASP ASVS and the Cheat Sheets in daily use

videos.script: Every lesson of this course ended with one refusal the application owes. A real project needs the whole list. {{list}} Somebody has written it. It is called ASVS, the Application Security Verification Standard, and it is free. {{asvs}} Three hundred and forty-five requirements. Each one starts with verify that, and each one is true or false of your application. {{verify}} They come in three levels. Level one for every application. Level two for anything holding personal data, like a clinic's portal. {{levels}} The standard says what. A companion project, the OWASP Cheat Sheets, says how. {{cheats}} Today you download the standard as a file, read it with a short program, and map this whole course onto it. {{today}}
